summary: Repaired the test output configuration: CSV now writes result.csv, matching the runner's expected filename. Removed deprecated large_kinematics parameters from the test's stress-divergence kernels; large kinematics remains enabled on ComputeLagrangianStrain. All analytical checks and tolerances are unchanged. Both source files and the full model input are retained. The supplied log confirms successful compilation, main-input validation, and the expected numerical test values; this repaired package has not been rerun here. Retained overrides: 100 × 100 nm domain, temperature-dependent reaction heats, and distinct disp_x/disp_y names. Retained assumptions: plane strain, virgin undeformed material, first-order Lagrange fields, reflective normal displacement with tangential slip, natural insulation, backward Euler for thermal/species equations, and Newmark beta=0.25/gamma=0.5 for inertia. Units remain nm–ns–GPa–K, including plastic reference rate 1000 ns^-1. Centerline CSV profiles are written at 25, 50 and 75 ps.

tests.name: undeformed_jwl_reference_state
tests.input:
# One element; homogeneous constrained reference state.
# Analytical values: J=1, ep=0, rho=rho0.
# With unreacted_jwl below, pressure=2 exactly at J=1 and T=300.
# Run serially; time limit 120 seconds. Check the final result.csv row.
[Mesh]
  type = GeneratedMesh
  dim = 2
  nx = 1
  ny = 1
  displacements = 'disp_x disp_y'
[]
[Variables]
  [disp_x]
    initial_condition = 0
  []
  [disp_y]
    initial_condition = 0
  []
[]
[AuxVariables]
  [temperature]
    initial_condition = 300
  []
  [Y1]
    initial_condition = 1
  []
  [jacobian]
    family = MONOMIAL
    order = CONSTANT
  []
  [plastic]
    family = MONOMIAL
    order = CONSTANT
  []
  [density]
    family = MONOMIAL
    order = CONSTANT
  []
  [pressure]
    family = MONOMIAL
    order = CONSTANT
  []
[]
[Materials]
  [constants]
    type = GenericConstantMaterial
    prop_names = 'rho0 specific_heat shear'
    prop_values = '1.82e-6 2355.592 10'
  []
  [strain]
    type = ComputeLagrangianStrain
    displacements = 'disp_x disp_y'
    large_kinematics = true
  []
  [stress]
    type = ViboraHotspotJWLJ2
    temperature = temperature
    reactant = Y1
    unreacted_jwl = '2 0 0 0 0.37'
  []
[]
[Kernels]
  [sx]
    type = UpdatedLagrangianStressDivergence
    variable = disp_x
    component = 0
    displacements = 'disp_x disp_y'
    use_displaced_mesh = true
  []
  [sy]
    type = UpdatedLagrangianStressDivergence
    variable = disp_y
    component = 1
    displacements = 'disp_x disp_y'
    use_displaced_mesh = true
  []
[]
[BCs]
  [x]
    type = DirichletBC
    variable = disp_x
    boundary = 'left right bottom top'
    value = 0
  []
  [y]
    type = DirichletBC
    variable = disp_y
    boundary = 'left right bottom top'
    value = 0
  []
[]
[AuxKernels]
  [j]
    type = MaterialRealAux
    variable = jacobian
    property = J
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [p]
    type = MaterialRealAux
    variable = plastic
    property = equivalent_plastic_strain
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [rho]
    type = MaterialRealAux
    variable = density
    property = current_density
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [pressure]
    type = MaterialRealAux
    variable = pressure
    property = pressure
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
[]
[Postprocessors]
  [J]
    type = ElementAverageValue
    variable = jacobian
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [ep]
    type = ElementAverageValue
    variable = plastic
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [rho]
    type = ElementAverageValue
    variable = density
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
  [p]
    type = ElementAverageValue
    variable = pressure
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
  []
[]
[Executioner]
  type = Transient
  solve_type = NEWTON
  dt = 0.001
  num_steps = 2
  nl_abs_tol = 1e-12
[]
[Outputs]
  [csv]
    type = CSV
    file_base = result
    append_object_name = false
    execute_on = TIMESTEP_END
    precision = 16
  []
[]
